notes: Read the web source line by line. Imports (L1-12): react hooks kept; react-router-dom useParams/useNavigate/useSearchParams (L2) are not wired on native and are adapted (see below); react-i18next useTranslation (L3) -> native English-default `t` with i18next `{{var}}` interpolation; @/hooks/usePageTitle (L4) dropped (document.title has no native analogue); @/api/hooks/useYearReview (L5) + @/api/hooks/useVehicles (L6) -> the native web-parity hooks ../../../api/hooks/useAnalytics + useVehicles (API paths /analytics/year-review and /vehicles preserved); @/components/feedback Spinner (L7) -> ActivityIndicator; @/components/ui Button/Select (L8) -> AppButton + a segmented pill group; @/lib/cn (L9) dropped for StyleSheet; lucide X/ChevronLeft/ChevronRight (L10) -> SemanticIcon 'close' (chevrons are desktop-only, see L156-179); ../components/review SlideRenderer + SLIDE_DEFS (L11) inlined natively (the native review barrel/SlideRenderer/slides.ts are not converted yet, only SavingsSlide); @/components/ai/AIYearReviewNarration (L12) -> the converted native ../../../components/ai/AIYearReviewNarration.

Component setup (L15-43): the full-screen-route EXCEPTION comment (L14) is preserved as the root full-screen black View. year (L21, Number(yearParam) || new Date().getFullYear()) -> new Date().getFullYear() since the route param is not wired (documented). usePageTitle (L22) dropped. vehicleIdParam (L25) keeps its exact name but is local useState('') instead of searchParams.get('vehicle_id'); useVehicles()/vehicleList (L26-27) and the vehicleOptions {value:String(v.id), label:v.display_name} memo (L28-31) are verbatim. data/isLoading = useYearReview(year, vehicleIdParam || undefined) (L40) verbatim. slideIndex useState(0) (L42) and slides = useMemo(SLIDE_DEFS) (L43) verbatim.

Effects + callbacks (L34-68): the auto-select-first-vehicle effect (L34-38) is preserved, calling setVehicleIdParam(String(vehicleList[0].id)) in place of setSearchParams. goNext Math.min(prev+1, slides.length-1) (L45-47) and goPrev Math.max(prev-1,0) (L49-51) verbatim via useCallback. The window 'keydown' Arrow/Space/Escape handler (L54-68) is dropped — RN has no physical-key window events; left/right tap zones provide prev/next and Escape's navigate(-1) maps to the close/dismiss control (documented).

Loading branch (L70-80): the fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black centered Spinner (text-secondary) + text-muted 'Building your year in review...' -> a flex:1 black View (testID year-review-loading) with an ActivityIndicator(color textSecondary) + muted AppText, keeping the yearReview.loading key + default verbatim.

No-data branch (L82-105): the data.total_drives === 0 && data.total_charge_sessions === 0 guard is preserved verbatim; the 🚗 emoji, secondary yearReview.noData '{{year}}' message (interpolated), muted yearReview.noDataHint, and the ghost Button -> AppButton(variant='ghost', label yearReview.goBack) whose onClick navigate(-1) (L97) maps to the native dismiss. testID year-review-empty.

Story shell (L107-196): root fixed inset-0 bg-black select-none -> flex:1 relative black View (testID year-review-page). Progress bar (L109-123): one flex track per slide over colors.surfaceRaised, filled (active) up to and including slideIndex, empty (w-0) beyond — the web past/current/future width logic condensed, pulse animation dropped (no native equivalent). Vehicle selector (L125-139, vehicleList.length > 1): the ControlSelect -> a segmented pill group (testID year-review-vehicle-select) honouring vehicleOptions, the value=vehicleIdParam highlight, and the onChange that sets vehicleIdParam + setSlideIndex(0) (L132-134). SlideRenderer (L142-146) -> the inlined native SlideRenderer with the same slideIndex/slide/data props.

Navigation chrome (L148-196): the three tap zones (L149-153, w-1/3 prev / middle / next) -> a row of zIndex-10 Pressables (year-review-tap-prev / year-review-tap-next) over a non-interactive middle View, with the same yearReview.prev/next aria labels. The desktop-only ChevronLeft/ChevronRight arrows (L156-179, hidden ... md:inline-flex) are omitted on native (mobile parity — they are hidden on small screens in web). The close X button (L181-191) -> a zIndex-20 Pressable (year-review-close) with SemanticIcon 'close', navigate(-1) -> dismiss. The slide counter '{slideIndex+1} / {slides.length}' (L193-196) -> a muted caption (year-review-counter). The AIYearReviewNarration block + its off-mode comment (L198-209) -> the native overlay receiving vehicleId={vehicleIdParam ? Number(vehicleIdParam) : undefined} verbatim.

Inlined SlideRenderer/SLIDE_DEFS parity: SLIDE_DEFS is copied verbatim from ../components/review/slides.ts (all 12 type/field/bg entries, bg gradient strings preserved). RN has no gradient primitive here, so each slide's bg maps via its `via-*-900` (or `from-*-900`) tailwind token to a representative `-900` hex backdrop, preserving per-slide colour identity. The dispatch mirrors the web SlideRenderer switch: the converted SavingsSlide renders for 'savings'; every other slide renders a native SlidePlaceholder carrying that slide's hero emoji + lead-in copy (🚗 title/year, 🛣️ distance, 🗓️ drives, 🏔️ longestDrive, ⚡ energy kWh, 🔌 chargeSessions, 🌍 co2Offset, 📊 drivingPatterns, 🌿 mostEfficient, funFacts, 🏆 summary), keeping every yearReview.* key verbatim. Unit-free metrics (total_drives, total_charge_sessions, total_energy_kwh, co2_offset_kg, year) are shown verbatim; distance/efficiency/duration that need the user's km/mi preference are deferred to each slide's own native conversion (SavingsSlide demonstrates the full wiring). framer-motion AnimatePresence/motion slide + entrance animations render at rest (the established idiom).

Native-safe adaptations summary (documented in-file): react-router useParams/useNavigate/useSearchParams, usePageTitle, the keydown handler, @/lib/cn, framer-motion, lucide-react, Recharts and old web UI components are all replaced by RN primitives + the shared native AppText/AppButton/SemanticIcon/theme tokens. A YearReviewPageParity.test.tsx mirrors the established page-parity harness (loading / no-data / story shell / multi-vehicle selector). Verified with cd apps/native; npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
